review.why: Set up or repair Prisma ORM safely: detect the installed version, connect the database, and keep Prisma 6 and 7 apps on their version.
review.summary: Detects the Prisma version, provider and runtime before acting. New apps default to Prisma ORM 8 and load the version-specific guidance shipped with the package; existing Prisma 6 and 7 apps keep their version, with provider references for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB and Prisma Postgres. It requires verifying with a read-only query.
strengths: Version-aware: it separates connection repair from major upgrades and warns against copying Prisma 7 examples into a Prisma 6 app.
Careful with secrets and data: loads environment files without printing them and diagnoses before running schema-changing commands.
Completion means a successful read-only query against the intended database, not just an install.
cautions: For Prisma 8 it relies on the package-owned guidance fetched with prisma skills sync, which this skill does not contain.
Reference files for providers target Prisma 7; the SKILL.md and the PostgreSQL and client setup references were read in full, the other provider references only skimmed.
Setup commands install packages and write configuration; examples were not run here.
